scope: The photographed 2024 public entrance wing of Saraswathi Mahal Library inside Thanjavur Palace, including its double arcade, recessed porch, painted façade and raised central niche.

references.filename: సరస్వతీ మహల్ గ్రంథాలయము, తంజావూరు (Saraswathi Mahal library, Tanjavur).jpg

originalReview.notes: The front-on exterior shows two recessed round arches, painted ornament, a powder-blue bilingual sign band and the raised central Saraswati niche. The cream return and light blue canopy sit beside the entry. Roof and rear details are outside the view.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact November 18, 2024 local Qualla file matches the photographer’s own CC0 native upload. The original is sufficient to reconstruct the public face. Depth, rear surfaces, roof and exact geographic alignment are estimated.
